newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sodexho rises on Q1 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Sodexho rises on Q1 turnover.

text.p: Shares in French contract catering company Sodexho outperformed the market on Wednesday, as the market welcomed its first quarter sales which were broadly in line with expectations, traders said.
The stock rose 1.66 percent to 2,880 francs at 1052 GMT.
Sodexho reported that sales for the three months to November 30 rose to 6.99 billion francs from 6.27 billion.

One broker said the shares rose despite the company reporting 7.2 percent organic growth which seemed to be below market expectations of between eight and 10 percent, but overall market sentiment was bullish. The market was up 0.39 percent.
